title: VERIFY cluster 1 (full adversarial replay, P-024 control-plane): precedent.py v2 whole surface plus the migrated live registry
description: Control-plane tier means full adversarial replay, not a README-tier skim (P-024, ORCHESTRATION.md:128-134). Verdict T-353, T-354 and T-355 together, because the interesting failures live between them: a schema that cannot load its own un-migrated records, a force model that reads a signal which does not exist, a migration that silently rewrites a published ratio. Replay, do not trust (ORCHESTRATION.md:100). Rotation slot 1: your identity must have produced no artifact in this epic, must not be `verifier-final`, and must differ from the identities executing T-360, T-361 and T-362 (F6, ORCHESTRATION.md:119-126).
acceptance_criteria: REPLAY THE COMMANDS YOURSELF, exactly: `python3 -m unittest discover -s .harness/tests -p "test_precedent*.py" -v` - QUOTE your own 'Ran N tests' line and assert N is strictly greater than 100, the count recorded at T-348 (P-025: exit 0 alone is not evidence, and a bare discovery command against a mismatched layout has already produced a false green in this repo, ORCHESTRATION.md:82-90). Then `python3 -m py_compile .harness/bin/precedent.py`. Then `python3 --version` to prove the CLI ran under the bare 3.9.6 interpreter, not a newer one - a 3.10+ construct at module scope would break every other agent on this bench.

WHOLE-SUBSTRATE REGRESSION: `python3 -m unittest discover -s .harness/tests -p "test_*.py" -v` - quote the Ran N line, confirm it is at least 146 (the count recorded at T-348) and green. The non-additive-interaction risk is measured, not hypothetical: stacking a component that re-does existing verification produced the only regression among four single-component swaps, -2.3pp (papers/agentic_harness_engineering.pdf:8 Table 3 RQ3a, p.9).

ATTACK THE INVARIANTS. Record each as pass/fail WITH THE EXACT COMMAND USED. (a) A corrective act citing no sources is REFUSED with exit 1 and no record file is created. (b) With the registry root overridden, nothing is written under .harness/precedents/ AND the live .harness/logs/events.jsonl line count is UNCHANGED across a full publish/confirm/overrule cycle - this is carried defect (i) from T-346 and it either got fixed or it did not; measure the line count before and after and paste both numbers. (c) The supersedes tier check behaves exactly as the synthesis directs, including the lower-tier-supersedes-higher refusal path - carried defect (ii). (d) Force is computed from registry data only: grep the implementation and PROVE it does not depend on a cite event, since `cite` writes nothing including events (SDR-23). (e) A decayed record's `status` field is UNCHANGED - no auto-expiry (addendum section 6). (f) The validity-conditions staleness pass is read-only: registry byte-identical before and after. (g) A schema_version 1 record is still loadable under the v2 CLI, or refused exactly as the synthesis directs - test it by restoring a v1 copy into a temp root, do not infer it. (h) A hand-corrupted v2 record is DETECTED (exit 4), never silently loaded. (i) grep the code and prove there is no write to state.json or blackboard.json and no new log file was created.

MIGRATION CONTENT PROOF, INDEPENDENTLY DERIVED - do not trust T-355's diff. Reconstruct the four pre-migration records from git (`git show HEAD:.harness/precedents/PR-001.json` and its three siblings; all four are tracked) and diff field by field against the live migrated versions. Every SDR-01 immutable field must be byte-identical: ratio, dicta, scope_conditions, declared_width, tier_evidence, cites, subject, title, issuing_task, published_by, published_at, authority_tier. The ONLY permitted differences are the additive v2 fields and the schema_version bump. Paste your own diff. Any other change is a REJECT of T-355.

RE-DERIVE THE IDEMPOTENCY CLAIM: run the migration a second time yourself and assert byte-identical output. Then verify the backfilled `sources` tokens actually resolve - run `python3 .harness/bin/precedent.py cite --all` and confirm the only dangling token in the registry is still PR-001's P-023, which is the designed demonstration of a real constitutional gap, not a defect.

CROSS-CHECK THE CLI AGAINST THE SYNTHESIS: for every V1-NN requirement in docs/precedent-research/synthesis-v1-requirements.md that names a flag, an exit code, a refusal or a stdout line, RUN THE REAL COMMAND and compare. Any mismatch is a REJECT naming the requirement id, the exact command and the exact observed behavior. A DEVIATION note from the producer is acceptable evidence of a disclosed departure; an undisclosed one is not.

VERDICT T-353, T-354 and T-355 INDIVIDUALLY: `python3 .harness/bin/blackboard.py update <T-ID> --status done --agent <you> --note "..."` for each that passes, or `--status open` with a REJECTED: note naming the exact failing command and its output for each that does not. Producer-distinct-from-approver is mechanical here: you produced none of the three.

This task may take the verifier-execute-done path (P-022) only because its acting identity differs from created_by (orchestration-planner). RECORD YOUR REVIEWER IDENTITY in the verdict note so the F6 rotation is auditable, and confirm in writing that you are not `verifier-final` and produced no artifact in this epic.

Reviewer tier: sonnet by default (adversarial replay is high-verifiability execution, P-030). The coordinator may override to frontier for this task alone if the force semantics or the migration immutability question prove contested (P-024, state.json cost_policy rules 3-4).
